subtitle: Connect your account to run campaigns
connect_desc: Next, Google asks for your consent for Hontrio to access Google Ads and Merchant Center. Hontrio reads campaigns, budgets, results, search terms and product statuses, creates and manages its own campaigns in your account, and adds a “Hontrio” data source in Merchant Center. Your existing campaigns only change if you choose so at launch. You pay Google directly for the ads, and you can revoke access at any time.
no_account: No Google Ads account? Create one
revoked_desc: Hontrio's access to your Google account was revoked or expired. Reconnect the account to continue.
no_accounts: We didn’t find any Google Ads account that can run campaigns. Check that you have access to the store’s account, or connect another Google account.
disconnect_confirm: Disconnect your Google account? Hontrio will no longer be able to manage your campaigns.
error_missing_scope: Google Ads access must be checked on the Google screen. Please try again.
error_no_refresh_token: The connection didn’t complete properly in Google. Please try again.
error_state: The connection session expired. Please try again.
error_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
error_not_configured: Connecting to Google isn’t available right now. Please contact support.
error_generic: The Google connection failed. Please try again.
warning_test_token: Your Google account is connected, but Hontrio has test access to the Google Ads API for now and can only read test accounts.
warning_discovery_failed: Your Google account is connected, but we couldn’t read your Google Ads accounts. Try again from Settings → Integrations with the “Refresh” button.
warning_generic: Your Google account is connected, but Google Ads returned an error ({{code}}).
per_store_hint: Each store runs its campaigns in its own account.
currency_mismatch: The account currency ({{account}}) differs from the store's ({{store}}), so budgets and sale values wouldn't match.
no_store: Connect a store first, then choose its Google Ads account.
clear_account: Don't use any account for this store
disconnect_confirm_remove: Disconnect your Google account? Hontrio permanently deletes the campaigns it created from Google Ads, with their budgets, and they can't be started again. Your other campaigns stay as they are.
campaigns_removed_one: We deleted {{count}} campaign created by Hontrio from Google Ads.
campaigns_removed_other: We deleted {{count}} campaigns created by Hontrio from Google Ads.
campaigns_remove_failed_one: {{count}} campaign created by Hontrio couldn't be deleted from Google Ads. Please delete it yourself in Google Ads.
campaigns_remove_failed_other: {{count}} campaigns created by Hontrio couldn't be deleted from Google Ads. Please delete them yourself in Google Ads.
